subject: general
question:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.
A false name used by an author instead of their real one.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Pseudonym.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Pseudonym** refers to a false name or a pen name used by an author instead of their real name.
 
• A **Sobriquet** is a nickname or an informal name given to someone, which is different from a pseudonym.
 
• An **Epithet** is a descriptive term or phrase expressing a characteristic of someone or something, often used in literature.
 
• **Cognomen** refers to a surname or family name, especially in ancient Roman naming conventions.

Correct usage: *An author often uses a **Pseudonym** to conceal their real identity.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pseudonym Examples:** 

 
 
• Mark Twain is the pseudonym of Samuel Langhorne Clemens.
 
• George Eliot is the pseudonym of Mary Ann Evans.
 
 
 
• **Why authors use pseudonyms:**
 
 
• To maintain anonymity.
 
• To write in a different genre without bias.
 
• To create a memorable or marketable name.
